unit.description: Verify login succeeds with valid username and password
unit.preconditions: System is loaded; default admin credentials exist
unit.expected: success: true, message contains Login successful

unit.description: Verify login fails when fields are blank or whitespace
unit.expected: success: false, message: Please enter both username and password.
unit.actual: success: false, message: "Please enter both username and password."

unit.description: Verify rejection of student name containing invalid symbols/numbers
unit.expected: isValid: false, error contains letters and spaces only
unit.actual: isValid: false, error: "Name must contain 2-50 characters with letters and spaces only."

unit.description: Verify duplicate roll numbers are prevented
unit.preconditions: Existing student with roll number 101 in database
unit.expected: isValid: false, error contains Roll number already exists
unit.actual: isValid: false, error: "Roll number '101' already exists. Duplicates are not allowed."

unit.description: Verify student deletion removes target record and leaves remainder intact
unit.expected: Student 101 removed, list length becomes 1 with only 102

unit.description: Verify formula: (Present / Total) * 100 for 15 present out of 20 classes
Verify eligibility status: 16/20 (80%) -> Eligible; 14/20 (70%) -> Short Attendance
Verify marking Present accepts and stores status successfully
unit.expected: success: true, record contains Present for 101
unit.actual: success: true, message: "Attendance recorded successfully for 2026-10-05 (1 students)."

unit.description: Verify marking Absent accepts and stores status successfully
unit.expected: success: true, record contains Absent for 102
unit.actual: success: true, message: "Attendance updated successfully for 2026-10-05 (1 students)."

unit.description: Verify system rejects invalid status values (e.g., "Late", "HalfDay")
unit.expected: success: false, message contains Invalid status
unit.actual: success: false, message: "Invalid status 'Late' for roll number 101. Must be 'Present' or 'Absent'."

system.description: Execute complete workflow: Login -> Add Student -> Mark Attendance -> Generate Report -> Verify Percentage

system.expected: Report confirms 100.00% attendance and Eligible status
system.actual: E2E Success: Found 120 with Pct: 100.00%, Status: Eligible
